# transform

Benchmarks of [`ordito.transform`](../api/ordito/transform.md) against every library that computes the same thing. Each chart shows the time of every library relative to ordito on CUDA (1x, in green): a longer bar took longer. The table under each chart lists every input the function was measured on. See [Benchmarks](index.md) for how to read and reproduce these numbers.

*Measured on GPU: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 · CPU: Intel Xeon w7-2495X*

## Without a reference

No other library computes these, so they have no comparison. ordito (CUDA)'s median time on the largest input it was measured on:

| Function | Input | ordito (CUDA) |
|---|---|---|
| `transform_points_inplace` | lucy | 237.8 µs |
| `transform_vectors` | lucy | 260.9 µs |
| `normal_matrix` | form=device | 110.6 µs |
| `classify_transform` | form=device | 227.0 µs |
| `transform_scale` | form=device | 82.0 µs |
| `as_mat44` | form=device | 77.9 µs |
| `matrix_to_numpy` | form=device | 68.8 µs |
| `reverses_orientation` | form=device | 62.3 µs |
